dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Tani district, Khost province as of 23 June 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20220622AFG** This map illustrates potentially damaged buildings and damaged buildings in Tani district, Khost province of Afghanistan as detected by Worldview-3 image acquired on 23 June 2022. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 156 potentially damaged buildings, 70 damaged buildings and 58 shelters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
